claimBoundary: The matrix repeats the JFIF-tagged source-grounded experiment across three independently specified full-resolution vertical Cb fields: a +2-code/row ramp, a -2-code/row ramp and a bounded piecewise +/-2-code/row zigzag. Each low-resolution Cb row is independently required to equal the integer average of the corresponding full-resolution row pair before encoding.
The matrix crosses each signal with baseline/progressive coding and 4:4:0/4:2:0 sampling. Horizontal chroma remains constant, so sampling-axis changes do not introduce a horizontal signal.

For every cell, the actual post-IDCT Cb plane is the reconstruction input. Global centered reconstruction must beat the iMCU-clamped counterfactual on held-out internal iMCU-boundary rows, and the libjpeg RGB path must preserve the source-defined boundary signal better than ImageCraft/ImageIO under a color map fit only on non-boundary rows.

This is a directional mechanism/quality matrix, not a JPEG normative filter rule, perceptual score or public pixel tolerance. Any cell that reverses either ordering fails the matrix rather than being averaged away.
